intro-1.text: Sometimes the best place for a one-click button is right in the middle of a reply.

intro-2.text: With CLICK-zenn, your agents can drop one into any ticket response, with just a click.

insert-1.text: Write your reply in the Zendesk ticket editor as usual, and place your cursor where the button should go.

insert-2.text: Then click the CLICK-zenn icon in the editor toolbar.

insert-3.text: A pop-up shows the buttons in your account, each one pictured just as it looks, so you pick by sight.

insert-4.text: Click one, and it lands right in your message, exactly as your customer will see it.

choice-1.text: Want to give your customer a choice? Add a second button right beside the first.

choice-2.text: CLICK-zenn fills in this ticket's details as each button goes in, so every link is ready to go.

choice-3.text: Add a closing line, send your reply, and you're done.

outro-1.text: It's perfect for the moments an automation won't catch: confirming a fix, gathering details, or offering next steps.

outro-2.text: Find CLICK-zenn on the Zendesk Marketplace, and put one-click answers into every reply.
